svg.title: SalamStay monogram
svg.desc: App-icon monogram — white "S" on a Salam Green (#2E7D6A) rounded square. Corner radius 8 on a 64 unit square (radii.md, 8/64 = 1:8 proportion). Clean geometric letterform, no ornament.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
